tasks.title: Above average
tasks.statement: Select the title and price of products priced above the average price. Get the average price with the subquery (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products).
tasks.hint: The subquery in parentheses returns a single number.

tasks.title: Below average
tasks.statement: Select the title of products cheaper than the average; order by title.

tasks.title: The most expensive
tasks.statement: Select the title of the most expensive product: price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products).

tasks.title: Larger than the average order
tasks.statement: Select the id and total of orders whose total is greater than the average order total; order by id.

tasks.title: Subquery in the column list
tasks.statement: Select title, price, and the difference from the average price diff = price − (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products), rounded to an integer with ROUND; order by product id.

tasks.title: IN: who has orders
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers who have orders: id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders); order by name.
tasks.hint: The subquery returns a column of values for IN.

tasks.title: NOT IN: no orders
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers without orders (NOT IN); order by name.

tasks.title: The NOT IN trap with NULL
tasks.statement: The brand for category `'Art supplies'` is unknown (NULL), and NOT IN with such a list returns nothing. Select the title of products whose brand matches none of the known brands of category `'Art supplies'` (add WHERE brand IS NOT NULL to the subquery); products with an unknown brand are not part of the answer. Order by title.
tasks.hint: If an IN/NOT IN list contains NULL, the result of NOT IN becomes undefined.

tasks.title: EXISTS
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers who have a cancelled order (EXISTS with a subquery on orders.customer_id = c.id and status = `'cancelled'`); order by name.

tasks.title: NOT EXISTS
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers who have no paid orders (NOT EXISTS); order by name.

tasks.title: Correlated subquery
tasks.statement: For each customer select the name and the number of their orders n: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id); order by customer id.
tasks.hint: The subquery refers to the outer row c.

tasks.title: A customer's largest order
tasks.statement: For each customer select the name and the largest total of their orders best (NULL if there are no orders); order by id.

tasks.title: Subquery in FROM
tasks.statement: Select the title and value (price * stock) only for products whose value is greater than 100000. First compute value in a subquery in FROM; order by value descending.
tasks.hint: A subquery in FROM works as a temporary table.

tasks.title: Filter twice
tasks.statement: From the subquery "paid orders" select the three largest: id and total. The subquery: SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE status = `'paid'`.

tasks.title: More expensive than any grocery
tasks.statement: Select the title of products that are more expensive than the most expensive product of category `'Groceries'` (price > MAX); order by title.

tasks.title: Cheaper than any book
tasks.statement: Select the title of products that are cheaper than the cheapest book (category `'Books'`); order by title.

tasks.title: Two levels of nesting
tasks.statement: Select the id of orders that contain `'Laptop Air 13'`: order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items WHERE product_id = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE title = `'Laptop Air 13'`)); order by id.

tasks.title: Anna's fellow townspeople
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers from the same city as `'Anna Petrova'`, except her; order by name.

tasks.title: Later than Boris
tasks.statement: Select the name of customers who registered later than `'Boris Ivanov'`; order by registered.

tasks.title: Same-category neighbors
tasks.statement: Select the title of products in the same category as `'Mouse Click'`, except itself; order by title.

tasks.title: The largest order
tasks.statement: Select the id and total of the largest order (a subquery with MAX).

tasks.title: Second-highest price
tasks.statement: Select the second-highest product price as second: MAX(price) among products whose price is less than the maximum.

tasks.title: Orders with electronics
tasks.statement: Select the id of orders that contain at least one electronics item (EXISTS and a JOIN in the subquery); order by id.

tasks.title: Scalar subqueries
tasks.statement: In a single row, output the number of customers customers_n and the number of products products_n using two scalar subqueries.

tasks.title: HR: employees of Moscow departments
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name of employees of departments located in Moscow (dept_id IN (SELECT id FROM departments WHERE city = `'Moscow'`)); order by id.

tasks.title: HR: departments without employees
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name of departments that have no employees (NOT EXISTS).

tasks.title: HR: above the department average
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name and salary of employees who earn more than the average salary of their department (a correlated subquery on dept_id); order by name.

tasks.title: HR: the best in a department
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name, dept_id and salary of employees with the highest salary in their department (ignore employees without a department); order by dept_id.

tasks.title: HR: who manages
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name of employees who are somebody's manager (id IN (SELECT boss_id …)); order by id.

tasks.title: HR: rank and file
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name of employees who have no subordinates (NOT EXISTS); order by id.

tasks.title: HR: above the company average
tasks.statement: HR database. Select the name and salary of employees whose salary is above the company average; order by salary descending.

tasks.title: School: enrolled in math
tasks.statement: School database. Select the name of students who have an enrollment in the course `'Math'` (id IN a subquery with two levels); order by name.

tasks.title: School: the longest course
tasks.statement: School database. Select the title of courses with the greatest number of hours; order by title.

tasks.title: School: above average
tasks.statement: School database. Select the name of students who have a grade above the school average (EXISTS); order by name.

tasks.title: Movies above the average rating
tasks.statement: Movies database. Select the title and rating of movies with a rating above the average; order by rating descending, then by title.

tasks.title: Directors of recent movies
tasks.statement: Movies database. Select the name of directors who have a movie released after 2015 (EXISTS); order by name.

tasks.title: Nolan's colleagues
tasks.statement: Movies database. Select the title of all movies by the director of the movie `'Inception'`, except `'Inception'` itself; order by title.
